name: motor-claims-api

dependencies.name: email-service
dependencies.description: Sends the claimant a confirmation email once their claim is submitted.

description: Owns the claimant's motor claims: creating and updating a draft, attaching the driving-licence and bank-page documents, submitting a completed claim (immutable from then on, and triggering a confirmation email), and listing and reading the caller's own claims. Stores claims and attachments in its own Postgres database. Does not process, approve or pay claims — that is outside this build.
